correctness.rationale: Exact distances and all cross distances <=3 establish K_3=Cl(H)*Cl(L(H)). Adamaszek 2011 Theorem 5.2 identifies the second factor with a simply-connected 2-skeleton with second-homology rank c=v-e+t-1. Thus it is a wedge of c 2-spheres; the multipartite clique complex is a wedge of b spheres of dimension k-1, so their join is a wedge of bc spheres of dimension k+2. Adamaszek Theorem 5.1 gives the known radius-two stage; graph counts give radius one; diameter four gives termination. Distinct-degree stages imply barcode, all homology torsion-free. Independent finite graph and mod-2 tests for (2,2,2),(2,2,3) reproduce predictions; finite experiments are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural all-parameter family has an exact first radius-three high-dimensional homotopy jump to bc spheres of dimension k+2, contrasting the two preceding topological stages and providing all integral persistence intervals. The exact join criterion identifies the structural cause and is sharp among once-subdivided connected graphs. This goes beyond arbitrary finite examples or mere recomputation of previously known scale-two results.
